about.title: Built Around Hospitality Procurement
paragraphs: Royal Tide General Trading LLC SPC is a United Arab Emirates general trading company supplying operating equipment and supplies to the hospitality sector.
The company is licensed and registered as a General Trading LLC SPC in the UAE, and trades under that licence for the import and supply of commercial hospitality goods.
Our focus is a curated, commercial-grade range — tableware, cutlery, glassware and bed & bath linen — specified for the realities of daily service, industrial washing and guest-facing presentation.
about.mission: To make hospitality procurement straightforward: a focused range of dependable, presentation-ready supplies, sourced and delivered for regional hotels, restaurants and catering operations.
